sequence_points.name: Landscape with Yellow Field and Blue Sky
sequence_points.description: A vibrant landscape painting featuring a golden-yellow field in the foreground, green rolling hills in the midground, and a bright blue sky above. The artwork is mounted on a wall and appears to be framed.

sequence_points.name: Still Life with Fruit and Vase
sequence_points.description: A colorful still life painting featuring a composition of fruit, including oranges and possibly grapes, arranged on a table with a vase in the background. The artwork uses bold, warm colors and appears to be mounted on a museum wall with a dark frame.

sequence_points.name: Landscape with River and Trees
sequence_points.description: A framed landscape painting depicting a river winding through a natural scene with trees and distant hills. The composition uses earthy tones and soft brushwork, mounted on a museum wall with a simple wooden frame.

sequence_points.name: Abstract Figure in Motion
sequence_points.description: A dynamic abstract painting featuring a stylized human figure in motion, rendered in earthy tones with bold brushwork. The artwork is mounted on a museum wall, framed in a simple dark border.
